messages:
Maya: Hey folks — thinking about a casual outing: arcade night + brunch the next weekend. Two quick options: 1) Arcade (6:30pm) -> late-night bites 2) Brunch first (11am) -> arcade afternoon. Which do you prefer? Also who wants to chip in for a 2-hour game card? :video_game: :pancakes:
Tom: Option 1 for me — I can make evenings. Count me in for a game card ($10?). :+1:
Priya: Brunch-first please — Saturday mornings are the only time I can be kid-free. Also gluten-free friendly spots?
Sam: Option 1 but I can do either. +1 on the $10 game card. Can I bring my +1?
Maya: @Sam absolutely, bring a +1. Planning on reserving a lane/area depending on numbers.
Devon: I can bring a couple of travel board games if people want a quieter table later (Codenames, Azul). Option 1 works.
Leah: Brunch-first vote from me. Also I can drive 3 people from SoMa if helpful.
Priya: Thanks @Leah — that would help. I can bring a couple of GF muffins if needed.
Tom: Quick logistics Q: arcade has limited redemption tickets — are we doing prizes or just chill?
Maya: Maybe small prizes (snacks/arcade trinkets) — nothing formal. If people want to donate a $5-ish prize, lmk.
HR Bot: Poll created: "Arcade then evening vs Brunch then arcade" — vote below. (Poll closes in 48h)
Maya: Also, who needs to be on the RSVP list for the venue? I'll make a short Google form with names + dietary notes + bring-a-plus-one.
Sam: Add Sam, +1 (name TBA).
Devon: Add Devon. I can help handle board games setup.
Tom: Add Tom. Happy to handle the game card bulk purchase.
Leah: Add Leah + 2 (carpool seats).
Priya: Add Priya. GF muffins offered.
Maya: Thanks! If poll leans one way I'll lock in a reservation and post the exact address/time. If it's split, leaning toward Option 1 (arcade eve) because it's easier to reserve evening space.
Tom: :thumbsup: Sounds good. Excited.
Devon: :video_game: :coffee:
Leah: Cute idea — also can we do a short playlist? I can throw together a chill 90s/indie playlist for the table.
Maya: Love that — @Leah please do. I'll add a link in the event RSVP.
HR Bot: Poll results (48h): Arcade evening 6 votes, Brunch-first 4 votes. Event confirmed: Arcade night -> late bites. Reservation time: 6:15pm. Venue: Press Start Arcade (link: https://pressstart.example). Please fill the RSVP form by Friday.
Maya: Reservation made for 10 people at 6:15pm. RSVP form: https://forms.example/arcade-night. If anyone's on the fence, still room to add.
Priya: Thanks for booking! Appreciate the GF option.
Tom: I'll pick up the game cards and bring cash for prizes.
Sam: Thanks everyone — see you there.
Maya: Closing thread — will DM folks with any last-minute changes. :sparkles:
